companies.source: Wikidata: items with P361 (part of) = Q242345 (S&P 500), joined to SEC company_tickers.json by P5531 (CIK)
companies.note: 527 source items; 510 distinct CIKs. Company coverage includes sponsors with current SEC ticker evidence; sponsor-only identities are not assumed to be currently traded companies. Membership is as Wikidata records it, including former constituents, not the index provider's official list.
